mapping.author: claude-mapper-m6
mapping.draft_py:
# Nessian Hornbeetle (FDN), a 2/2 Insect for {1}{G}.
# "At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another creature with power 4 or
#  greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature."
# Event and effect: M21 Adherent of Hope's verified B2a-adherent-of-hope ("At the beginning of
#   combat on your turn, if you control a Basri planeswalker, put a +1/+1 counter on this
#   creature."): TurnPhaseEvent COMBAT with actor YOU, PUT_COUNTER 1 on the source.
# Condition (the intervening "if", CR 603.4): M21 Turret Ogre's verified B2a-turret-ogre, the
#   same words "if you control another creature with power 4 or greater"
#   (CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1 over your creatures with power 4 or greater, FNot IS_SOURCE).
combat = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.COMBAT,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=1),
        inner_filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.POWER_GE, count=QConst(value=4)),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [combat, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mapping.notes: M21 Adherent of Hope's beginning-of-combat counter (verified) with M21 Turret Ogre's verified condition 'if you control another creature with power 4 or greater'. Pack: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/nessian_hornbeetle_power_three_or_itself_is_not_enough.json.
